claimBoundary: This is a stopped diagnostic, not paired evidence, a benchmark score, an adapter win, or promotion evidence. It records why the run was invalid and what the compiler changed before any fresh comparison.

findings.detail: The router treated source-ledger transformation and open five-fact synthesis as one lesson-kernel family even though every admitted training row used the source-ledger contract.
The local server returned modelCalls per route, but apiTraceSummary dropped that field; the retained browser log therefore counted transport requests rather than all native generations.
The adapter repeatedly produced truncated facts, duplicate options, source-answer conflicts, and incomplete kernels when used outside its learned source-grounded task.

resolution.pipeline: Base Gemma synthesizes facts; the compiler freezes valid facts; the adapter authors a source-grounded teaching kernel; only a proven, fully admitted adapter result replaces the base draft.
resolution.evaluation: Native model calls are retained in route traces, persisted in run receipts, emitted in paired evidence, and used by promotion efficiency gates.
